approved_payload.content: Police say officers responding to a complaint at a couple's home in Siyabuswa found William Malapane, 44, with stab wounds to his upper body; he was declared dead at the scene at about 02:00. It is alleged the couple argued before his wife, 40, stabbed him with a sharp object (police spokesperson Colonel Mavela Masondo, via Middelburg Observer). She was arrested on 4 October, charged with murder and denied bail in the Mdutjana Magistrate's Court on 14 October. The victim is named as reported, by the owner's decision of 23 October; the suspect is not named here. One report, resting on police: Middelburg Observer, 19 October. The date is read from the arrest date; the report does not state the date of death. The pin is approximate (town level).
